reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and computes the tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold used for matching, rather than restating 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass the operator.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts in the single expected-amount function the server paths already route through.

scope.why: Only the amount function, its server call sites and a test.

maintainability.why: The operator is an optional third positional argument after a boolean (`getScheduledAmount(x, false, op)`), so callers that omit it silently keep the old rule, as the desktop-client callers (e.g. Balance.tsx scheduled balance) still do.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All updated paths go through getScheduledAmount; none re-implements the rule.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the tolerance comes from getApproxNumberThreshold.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) and the six server call sites pass the op, but because op is optional the desktop-client callers (accounts/Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit.ts) call it without op and do not apply the approximate rule.
